lines.369680624231460866: I need to find him... Like... If I don't... I just know something terrible will happen.
lines.369680624231460867: Is that a feeling or do you know for sure?
lines.369680624235655169: Chasing a man into the storm of a century over a feeling.
lines.369680624235655171: I guess a feeling like that doesn't just come from nowhere. Just be careful where that takes you.
lines.369680624239849472: My wife and I lived in this building back when everything was brand new. Modernity, here in Silver Pines!
lines.369680624239849474: Do you think it's safe to go inside?
lines.369680624244043776: If I say no, will that keep you?
lines.369680624244043779: That place is crawling with bad memories. Still, memories can't hurt a man, can they?
lines.369680624244043780: Lots of old memories in this place.
lines.369680624252432384: Times have changed, the Union building is not what it used to be.
lines.369680624256626688: Got what you came here for?
lines.369680624256626689: Not yet. Don’t even know if I’m getting closer.
lines.369680624256626691: I can't. I have to find Eddie Velvet.
lines.369680624260820993: You're pursuing this goal as if your life depended on it, and you don’t know why?
lines.369680624260820994: It’s just something I have to do.
lines.369680624265015296: No one has to do anything except die, and in my view it’s better to put that off for as long as you can.
lines.369680624265015297: You have an obsession. It's gonna end up killing you. And for what?
lines.369680624269209600: You don't understand. I don't have a choice!
lines.369680624269209602: There's no other way. I'm stuck, okay? I have to finish this.
lines.369680624269209603: Maybe things aren't as bad as you think. Sure it's dark right now, but you're still in one piece more or less.
lines.369680624269209604: You'll find a way, even if you don't see it now. Keep your eyes open.
lines.369680624273403905: I believe in you. I think you'll get through whatever it is you're going through, and that everything will be all right.
lines.369680624273403906: It's your life and your choice in how to spend it.
lines.369680624281792512: You will know what is best for you.
lines.369680624285986816: Did you find the man you were looking for?
lines.369680624285986817: I did, but I... I couldn't go through with it. The job, I mean.
lines.369680624285986818: Oh? So you had second thoughts?
lines.369680624290181120: Something was off. I don't know.
lines.369680624290181121: Trusting that feeling again. Sounds wise to me. It got you this far, didn't it? Might just take you all the way.
lines.369680624294375424: There are still loose ends. I keep thinking there's more to this.
lines.369680624294375425: Well, there you go. Maybe there is some hope after all. Sounds like you had a choice all along but you just didn't see it.
lines.369680624294375426: That's the nature of things, the options aren't always laid out right in front of us.
lines.369680624294375427: Like you said, I've come this far. If there's more to it, I'll find out.
